name: Speed Boom
description:
About This Game

Push to the limits and reach frenetic and chaotic speeds by maintaining momentum through every corner.

Career mode

Get into career mode and race around an open world in fictional rally categories in order to qualify for the world championship where there’s only enough place for the best of the best.

Hunter mode

Tighten your seat belt because in hunter mode you will have to beat times set by the fastest players in the world, the question is: can you keep up?

Quick race mode

Hop into quick race mode and play alone or with your friends in split screen multiplayer any race, any car, any time.
short_desc: Do you know what's better than driving fast? Driving fast with style! Speed Boom is all about trying to be the best, rally racing, high speed drifting, and climbing the global leaderboards.
